name: Feitian
tagline: China's EVA suit — derived from the Orlan, first flown on Shenzhou 7 in 2008
description: Chinese rear-entry EVA suit with architectural similarities to the Soviet Orlan design. First flown on Shenzhou 7 in 2008 when Zhai Zhigang became the first Chinese taikonaut to spacewalk. Now in operational use on the Tiangong space station's Wentian airlock. The name means "flying heaven" — a reference to the celestial flying spirits (feitian) from Buddhist cave art at Dunhuang, depicted on the suit's arm badge.
best_known_for: China's EVA suit — used by Zhai Zhigang on the country's first spacewalk during Shenzhou 7
